summary: Wave 3 testing completed: RnD Approval Cockpit, Management Alerts, Production Tracking fixes, and audit script. Backend: 23/24 tests passed (95.8%). Frontend: RnD Cockpit fully functional with decision queue, approve/reject flow, funnel, and KPIs. Management alerts displaying correctly. Scheduler job registered and working (alerts created successfully). Audit script identified 5 zombie menu candidates (all have backend writers, so 'unused features' not true zombies). Demo data preserved correctly.

minor_issues.impact: Cosmetic - scheduler is working correctly, just not logging job names at startup

navigation_issues.issue: Some portal menu items difficult to locate via text selectors in automated testing
navigation_issues.impact: Testing only - manual navigation works fine
